cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(onboarding_log_probe LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Qml Quick)
if(NOT DEFINED EDI_SOURCE_ROOT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The log probe requires the source tree under test")
endif()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/app_build_info.hpp"
  "#define EDI_APP_VERSION \"metadata-unused\"\n#define EDI_APP_DATE \"metadata-unused\"\n#define EDI_APP_CRYSTA_VERSION \"metadata-unused\"\n#define EDI_APP_CRYSTA_COMMIT \"metadata-unused\"\n#define EDI_APP_GUI_COMMIT \"metadata-unused\"\n")
if(EXISTS "${EDI_SOURCE_ROOT}/app/src/run_log.cpp")
add_executable(log_probe log_probe.cpp "${EDI_SOURCE_ROOT}/app/src/run_log.cpp" "${EDI_SOURCE_ROOT}/app/src/run_log.hpp")
target_include_directories(log_probe PRIVATE "${EDI_SOURCE_ROOT}/app/src" "${EDI_SOURCE_ROOT}/core/include" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(log_probe PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Qml Qt6::Quick)
# The standalone probe exercises RunLog, not the host's SDK-dependent metadata providers.
target_compile_options(log_probe PRIVATE -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
if(APPLE)
  target_link_options(log_probe PRIVATE -Wl,-dead_strip)
else()
  target_link_options(log_probe PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections)
endif()

endif()
add_executable(payload_probe payload_probe.cpp)
target_link_libraries(payload_probe PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Qml)

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/web_control_geometry.inc")
add_executable(geometry_probe geometry_probe.cpp)
target_include_directories(geometry_probe PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(geometry_probe PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Qml Qt6::Quick)
endif()
